notes.title: Devlog #1 – Welcome and Game Overview
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hello, everyone![/h2][/b]
This is the first devlog for [i][b]My Stranger Family[/b][/i], and I'd like to share what you can expect moving forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569340/589766bc052ba2710576361935ff0e0e75d3985f.png[/img]

My Stranger Family is a creepy and comedic survival game about a guy secretly living in other people’s houses. It’s meant to be dark but also has a bit of humor. The game is planned to have two main modes:
[olist]
[*] [b]Story Mode:[/b] Includes 6 families/levels with a narrative focus.
[*] [b]Life Mode[/b] [i](not available in Early Access)[/i][b]:[/b] A more open-ended life simulation experience that lets you visit different places and live your own strange life more freely. (More details will be revealed in the future.)
[/olist]
I’m a solo developer working on this project, doing my best to make the game as close as possible to my vision. Most of the core features are in place, but the game is still in its early stages, and there’s still a lot left to do, so please keep an eye on the development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569340/2f616e09625cd73d20a61e983f2a580e6821ed2c.jpg[/img]

I’m aiming to release it in Early Access sometime this year (this is not a promise or confirmation, just my current goal). [b][i]More languages will be supported in the future.[/i][/b] For now, I’ll focus on completing the core gameplay loop and adding more families/levels. I’ll also try to post updates as often as I can.

Thanks for stopping by. [b]Wishlist the game[/b], and stick around!
